NVIDIA is a global leader in accelerated computing, powering breakthroughs in AI, graphics, autonomous vehicles, and scientific simulation.

* Shape measurability from pre\\-silicon through production — engage pre\\-silicon to challenge power modelling assumptions and establish measurement confidence levels; drive instrumented boards, rail maps, on\\-board sensors, and DAQ adapter design; specify, track, and escalate measurement prerequisites (telemetry, software build, validation, and agreed power targets with guard band policy), holding the requirement and escalating when it slips.
* Close power gaps and own release readiness — quantify and attribute power gaps to rail, IP, feature, and residency; drive debug and optimization alongside software and hardware power owners through experiments and recovery confirmation; deliver the power verdict that feeds program go/no\\-go decisions, backed by qualification data on every external software drop.
* Lead cross\\-company power engagement — converge measurement methodology and tooling with OEMs and software power owners; co\\-engineer shared battery\\-life targets, conduct joint root\\-cause analysis where measurements diverge, and maintain a common bug\\-and\\-analysis stream.
* Own the team's infrastructure portfolio and energy compliance — drive the in\\-house power profiling framework, power analytics dashboard, and automated power regression farm as production\\-grade shared assets; deliver energy\\-regulation compliance evidence (idle, standby, and off\\-mode power) required to clear product release gates.


 What we need to see
   

  

* BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with 8\\+ years of overall industry experience.

* Deep background in power systems, computer architecture, and SoC/platform power — with hands\\-on experience in power measurement, analysis, or power\\-stack debugging.
* Experience running or closely supporting a hardware measurement lab — instrumentation, device fleet, and the logistics that keep it productive.
* Demonstrated ability to engage across the full program lifecycle — from pre\\-silicon power modeling through bring\\-up, qualification, and post\\-commercialization sustaining.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to operate across engineering teams, program management, partner labs, OEM customers, and executive stakeholders.
* Commitment to measurement quality and the defensibility of data that drives product decisions.


 Ways to stand out from the crowd
